title_en: Jintan City Construction and Installation Engineering Company v. Daqing Qinglong Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — dispute over settlement of construction project
ruling_gist_en: In the trial of a dispute over a construction project contract, the court of first instance, in response to disputes between the developer and the contractor regarding the total cost of completed works, material analysis and price reduction, and costs for repairing unqualified works, based on the parties' applications, separately commissioned appraisal institutions to appraise the above matters. After the court of first instance organized cross-examination, the parties still raised objections to the appraisal conclusions and appealed. After supplementary cross-examination in the second-instance trial, if the parties failed to provide sufficient contrary evidence or rebuttal reasons against the appraisal conclusions, the probative force of the appraisal conclusions may be recognized.
